# External records: AI runs and reviews, kept as produced

This folder holds the raw records of work done by AI models in declared roles outside this repository's own code: red-team reviews, blind analyses, audits and the answers of the AAL workflow WF-0011, including one refusal. They are evidence of what each model was asked and what it returned, and several are sealed in the ledger, so they are kept exactly as produced.

**Language.** The team works in Romanian and English. Some prompts and AI answers in these records are partly or wholly in Romanian. They are not translated, because a translation would no longer be the record. Every finding taken from them is stated in English in the register (`docs/DECISION_ISSUE_IDEA_IMPLEMENTATION_REGISTER_v0.1.md`, RES-011 to RES-034) and in `docs/AI_AND_TOOLS_DISCLOSURE_v1.0.md`.

**Status.** These are model outputs, not GFL results. A claim in them counts only where GFL re-executed it; the register says which.
